title: Histone diversity in the archaeal domain of life
one_liner_zh: 该文利用生物信息学、结构预测和分子动力学模拟系统调查古菌组蛋白多样性及其与DNA的互作模式，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构与动态建模研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合机制分析。
abstract: Archaea represent a distinct domain of life that is genetically and biochemically unique from bacteria and eukaryotes. Two-thirds of all archaea encode histones, proteins that are ubiquitously used to structure chromatin in eukaryotes. Archaeal histone sequences are much less conserved than their eukaryotic counterparts, yet insight into how they structure DNA is limited to only a few species that fail to represent the diversity of the archaeal domain. Archaea have adapted to the most diverse and extreme environments on our planet, requiring protection of the genome against a multitude of external pressures. Here, we use bioinformatics, structure prediction, and molecular dynamics simulations to survey the diversity of histone-like sequences in all available archaeal genomes and to understand how they might interact with DNA. We have identified five distinct types of histones which are combined in seven different strategies, involving either single histones, multiple histones of the same type, or combinations of several types of histones in one genome. We show that some strategies correlate with environmental pressures, and some are phylogenetically restricted. Despite highly divergent amino acid sequences, structure predictions and simulations suggest similar histone DNA binding modes for most classes. Our work provides a guide to efficiently survey diverse strategies for histone-based DNA organization in archaea using biophysical and structural approaches, for a complete view of the rich diversity of histone strategies in the archaeal domain in a targeted manner.
abstract_zh: 古菌代表了一个生命域，其在遗传和生化上与细菌和真核生物截然不同。三分之二的古菌编码组蛋白，这些蛋白质在真核生物中普遍用于构建染色质。古菌组蛋白序列远不如其真核对应物保守，然而关于它们如何构建DNA的见解仅限于少数几个物种，这些物种未能代表古菌域的多样性。古菌已适应了我们星球上最多样化和极端的环境，需要保护基因组免受多种外部压力的影响。在此，我们利用生物信息学、结构预测和分子动力学模拟，调查所有可用古菌基因组中组蛋白样序列的多样性，并理解它们如何与DNA相互作用。我们识别出五种不同类型的组蛋白，它们以七种不同策略组合，涉及单一组蛋白、同类型多个组蛋白，或在一个基因组中组合多种类型的组蛋白。我们表明，一些策略与环境压力相关，而一些则受系统发育限制。尽管氨基酸序列高度分化，结构预测和模拟表明，大多数类别的组蛋白DNA结合模式相似。我们的工作提供了一种指南，通过生物物理和结构方法高效调查古菌中基于组蛋白的DNA组织策略，以定向方式全面了解古菌域中组蛋白策略的丰富多样性。
